title: n8n-io/n8n
lede: n8n is a fair-code TypeScript platform for building AI agents and automated workflows on a visual canvas, dropping into code where the canvas runs out, self-hosted or in n8n's cloud.

points: Multi-step AI workflows can combine tool use, branching logic, human approval steps and full observability.
Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or open-source models, and switching provider does not mean rebuilding the workflow.
JavaScript, Python and npm packages run alongside the visual nodes for anything the built-in steps cannot do.
The README lists 1500+ integrations and over 9,000 workflow templates; the repo topics include MCP client and server support.
Source is visible and self-hostable under the Sustainable Use License, with an enterprise license for extra features and support.
